meaning:
1) to whisper, charm, conjure
1a) (Piel) charmers, conjurers, whisperers (participle)
1b) (Hithpael) to whisper to each other

elsewhere.note: But when David saw that his servants were whispering together, David perceived that the child was dead; and David said to his servants, “Is the child dead?”…
All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.
